proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4435 *gharapāla compares Sindhi gharavāro husband and Hindi gharwālā householder/husband, with feminine gharwālī wife. Both gender forms fit this historical compound; local l/ḷ/r, loss of v and vowel contraction require review, and productive -vālā formation or regional diffusion may have reinforced it.
